```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

fit_data <- read.table("fit_2.txt", header = TRUE, sep="", fill=TRUE)

fit_data$event_num <- ifelse(fit_data$event == "y", 1, 0)

km_fit <- survfit(Surv(observed, event_num) ~ node, data = fit_data)

ggsurvplot(
  km_fit,
  data = fit_data,
  xlim = c(0, 60),         
  ylim = c(0.5, 1),             
  xlab = "Observed Months",
  ylab = "Survival Probability",
  legend.labs = c("Unmutated (Node 2)", "Mutated (Node 3)"),
  palette = c("#E7B800", "#2E9FDF"), 
  ggtheme = theme_minimal()
)
```
 We can observe that unmutated IGHV status has poor survival prognostic than IGHV mutates status. This is consistent with current literature.
